highlights: EU261 revision received final Council clearance on 13 July 2026: codified 'extraordinary circumstances' definition, no-show clause ban, hand-baggage-inclusive price display, reinforced PRM rights. Applies 12 months + 20 days after OJ publication (~H2 2027).

T-656/24 (NI and HZ v European Air Charter AG, 04.03.2026): extraordinary circumstance on an earlier rotation leg excuses a later flight only with a direct causal link; carrier's own choice to wait for connecting passengers is not extraordinary -> EUR 400 each awarded.
C-45/24 (15.01.2026): cancellation refund must include the intermediary/booking-portal commission where the carrier accepted ticket issuance in its name and for its account.
